Title: SEC-01 a protected endpoint without a token answers 401

Step Action: GET /api/v1/customers/me with no Authorization header
Step Expected: HTTP 401 in the standard error shape

Title: SEC-02 an expired or malformed token answers 401

Step Action: Call a protected endpoint with an expired access token, then with a token whose signature is altered

Title: SEC-03 a revoked token is rejected

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: POST /api/v1/auth/token/revoke, then GET /api/v1/auth/token/me with the same token

Title: SEC-04 each login endpoint accepts only its own user type

Step Action: Sign in as john_doe on /api/v1/auth/staff/login
Sign in as teller_alice on /api/v1/auth/customers/login

Title: SEC-05 a failed sign-in does not reveal whether the username exists

Step Action: Sign in with a real username and a wrong password, then with an unknown username
Step Expected: Same status and same body for both

Title: SEC-06 too many sign-in attempts from one address are limited

Step Action: Run scripts/test_rate_limiting.ps1, or send sign-in requests above 10 per second with a burst over 20
Step Expected: HTTP 429 once the limit is passed

Step Action: Wait and sign in normally

Title: SEC-07 a customer cannot read another customer 360

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: GET /api/v1/customers/{another customer id}/360

Title: SEC-08 a customer cannot read another customer account

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: GET /api/v1/accounts/2

Title: SEC-09 a customer cannot read another customer transaction or timeline

Step Action: As a customer who is neither sender nor receiver, GET /api/v1/transactions/{id} and its /timeline

Title: SEC-10 a customer asking for the staff timeline gets three stages

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: GET /api/v1/transactions/{own id}/timeline?view=STAFF
Step Expected: Three stages only; no internal stage detail

Title: SEC-11 a customer token cannot call a ledger endpoint

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: GET /api/v1/ledger/accounts/1/balance

Title: SEC-12 only an admin can trigger end of day

Step Action: POST /api/v1/batch/eod/trigger as a customer
POST /api/v1/batch/eod/trigger as teller_alice

Title: SEC-13 only an admin can remove a flag or decide a closure

Step Action: Sign in as teller_alice (POST /api/v1/auth/staff/login)
Try to remove an account flag
Try to approve a closure request

Title: SEC-14 only staff can open accounts, change status and reverse transfers

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: Try K3 open account, K5 status change and T5 reversal with the customer token

Title: SEC-15 only an admin can list and replay dead-letter records

Step Action: GET /api/v1/notifications/admin/dlq as a customer and as a teller

Title: SEC-16 a customer cannot mark another customer notification

Step Action: Sign in as customer john_doe with the seeded demo password (POST /api/v1/auth/customers/login)
Step Expected: HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token

Step Action: Mark as read a notification ID that belongs to another customer

Title: SEC-17 internal paths are not reachable through the gateway

Step Action: GET /internal/v1/sagas/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 on port 8080, with and without a valid user token
Step Expected: Refused by the gateway (403 from the perimeter filter); the request never reaches a service

Title: SEC-18 internal endpoints accept only a service token

Step Action: On the local stack, call an /internal/v1 endpoint on a service port directly with a customer token, then a staff token

Title: SEC-19 gateway route listing is not exposed

Step Action: GET /actuator/gateway/routes on port 8080

Title: SEC-20 on-premises services are not reachable from the internet

Step Action: From outside Azure, try ports 8082, 8083, 8085 and 8093 of the on-premises VM
Step Expected: No route: the VM has no public address and the NSG admits only the AKS subnet

Title: SEC-21 an inbound inter-bank message with a bad signature is refused

Step Action: Send an I1 message with an altered body or a wrong HMAC

Title: SEC-22 errors use the standard shape and leak nothing

Step Action: Trigger a 400, a 403, a 404 and a 5xx
Step Expected: Each body has the problem shape with an errorCode; none has a stack trace, SQL or a class name

Title: SEC-23 a service does not start when a secret is missing

Step Action: Start each service with JWT_SECRET (and its other secrets) unset
Step Expected: Startup fails with a clear message; no built-in default is used

Title: SEC-24 CORS admits only the configured origins

Step Action: Send a preflight to the gateway with an Origin that is not configured
Repeat with the staff console origin
